definitions.explanation: Prearranged plans or procedures for carrying out something. Implies that steps have been thought out and coordinated in advance.

examples.japanese: {手筈|てはず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
{手筈|てはず}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手筈|てはず}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すべて⟦{整|ととの}っている→整う：03935_totonou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: All arrangements for the event are in order, so please don't worry.

notes:
{手筈|てはず} refers to prearranged plans or procedures that have been thought out and coordinated in advance. It implies careful, deliberate planning rather than casual preparation.

FORMS:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand/method) + {筈|はず} (expectation/arrangement).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手筈|てはず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to make arrangements
- {手筈|てはず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧: arrangements are in place
- {手筈|てはず}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: according to plan
- {手筈|てはず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on the arrangements

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: preparations (general, everyday)
- ⟦{段取|だんど}り→段取り：06629_dandori⟧: arrangements, steps (practical scheduling)
- ⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧: arrangements (often for logistics — booking, dispatching)
- {手筈|てはず}: coordinated plan (more deliberate, formal)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. Common in business, organizational, and literary contexts. In casual speech, ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ or ⟦{段取|だんど}り→段取り：06629_dandori⟧ is more natural.
